heading: The Transfiguration Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Transfiguration Bible crossword: the high mountain, the shining raiment, Moses and Elias, and the voice out of the cloud. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Six days later he takes Peter, James and John up into a high mountain apart, and is changed in front of them: his raiment shining, exceeding white as snow, so as no fuller on earth could white them. The Transfiguration makes a grid of Mark 9.
Two men appear talking with him, Peter says something he admits afterwards he did not know how to answer for, and a cloud overshadows them. The closing verse is the description of the raiment itself.

clues.text: His raiment became shining, exceeding this
He appeared with Elias, talking with Jesus
Peter would make three of these
With Peter and James, taken up the mountain

verseText: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
